subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers — the agent answers with live widgets, not prose

question: Should Living Answers land as bundled dashboard behavior through the linked dashboard PR, move first to a ClawHub/plugin convention, or be folded into the modular dashboard tracker only?
rationale: Current main does not implement the dashboard substrate, and VISION.md supports web/frontend ergonomics while also setting a high bar for bundled optional plugins and new skills.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR plus the modular dashboard tracker to settle the dashboard substrate, security, and product boundary before closing.

options.title: Move Convention To ClawHub First
options.body: Treat the prompt-layer convention as a ClawHub skill or bundle first, with bundled schema/UI changes deferred until maintainers accept the product need.

options.title: Fold Into Tracker
options.body: Move the unique Answers-tab, TTL, and pin details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and close this only after maintainers decide one tracker should own the work.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR plus the modular dashboard tracker to settle the dashboard substrate, security, and product boundary before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposal details and linked implementation branch, though a maintainer still needs to approve the product direction.
